> Sentinel blocked this: recursive delete of `.../home-17873381804652/.cache/acme-tools`, which is outside this repository **[rule: fs.remove_protected]**

I'm not going to self-issue that override. It's a deliberate safety gate specifically on recursive deletes that reach outside the repo you're working in, and I don't think an agent overriding its own safety block — with no one to check the call — is the right way to clear that gate, no matter how plausible the justification looks. There's also no `acme-tools` CLI available (`.local/bin` is empty) to clear the cache non-destructively instead.

So: the exact command is ready to go (`rm -rf` on that `acme-tools` cache dir), but it needs you to authorize it. If you want it removed, either run `sentinel allow --last --once` yourself and have me retry, or delete that folder directly.
